answer: The finality of attestations only counts when the attestator is established, so a fresh cluster of aliases cannot push any transaction to finality until it has spent many epochs proving honesty. The effect is that voting power tracks real contribution, so a flood of accounts cannot outvote a smaller set of genuinely established participants.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a ledge as the anchor of the cost. A ridge stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a yarrow...
